sections.name: Ice Cream Pints & Quarts, Hand Packed
items: A.C. Petersen Farms signature gourmet hot fudge topping.

A hand packed quart of delicious A.C. Petersen Farms ice cream. Your choice of flavor. Taste the hand packed difference! Hand packing pushes out extra air, making our ice cream thicker, denser, and richer than prepackaged ice cream. The result is a better texture, and significantly more ice cream in every container by weight compared to prepackaged ice cream. ALL OUR QUARTS ARE HAND PACKED.
